skill.name: TikTok 获取用户作品

profile.title: TikTok username or profile URL
profile.description: Enter a username, @username, or official TikTok profile URL.

count.title: Maximum videos to return
count.description: Maximum number of results. Returns all currently accessible videos if fewer are available.

maxScrollTimes.title: Maximum scrolls
maxScrollTimes.description: Upper limit for loading more videos. Stops early when the target count is reached.

sortBy.title: Video sort order
sortBy.description: newest and oldest sort by time; profile keeps TikTok’s page order.

waitSeconds.title: Profile load wait (seconds)
waitSeconds.description: Wait for the profile and its first videos to load.

scrollWaitSeconds.title: Wait after each scroll (seconds)
scrollWaitSeconds.description: Increase this on slower pages. A value that is too low may miss later videos.

saveResults.title: Save user and videos to Tobub
saveResults.description: Results are returned either way. When disabled, nothing is written to the Tobub library.

fields.label: TikTok username or profile URL

fields.label: Maximum videos to return

fields.label: Video sort order

fields.label: Profile load wait (seconds)
